description: Retells Kundera’s The Unbearable Lightness of Being through Tomas and Tereza, Sabina and Franz, as love, exile, and political pressure intersect with the 1968 Soviet-led invasion of Czechoslovakia. Follows the four intertwined lives and the rural ending whose tenderness is intensified by deaths announced earlier.
